Three replayed programs check independent labelled enumerations through n=6, exact matrix identities, and both original update rules on all 66,420 configurations at n=2..5. Finite computations are corroboration, not an infinite proof. n=2 lacks rate one; n>=3 exhibits all three.

value.rationale: The graph family is a natural width-two excitable network. A nonzero individual four-cycle supports rate 3/4, but exactly a pair of consecutive equally charged squares creates rate one; the exact recurrence resolves how initial-color basins are distributed and proves maximal activity becomes exponentially typical as length grows. These are structural and quantitative distinctions not supplied by the general activity theorem or by counts of immediate primitive-three states. No claim is made about entry times or future applications.
